question.name: The Great Totem Dispute
question.text: Two villagers quarrel about which totem deserves the greatest honor.

choices.label: Hold a celebration for the totems.

a1.text: The celebration becomes a beloved festival.

a2.text: Rival speeches last so long that the food grows cold.

a3.text: A child asks why the village must choose only one. The adults fall silent, then laugh.

b1.text: The elder recalls the founders' journey and brings both sides together.

b2.text: The elder accidentally insults both factions and must apologize publicly.

b3.text: The elder proposes a shared ceremony.
